cards.text: Anwar warned in July 2025 that Mossad is operating inside Malaysia and recruiting citizens to spy.
cards.sub: The proof on the table is one Israeli jailed for guns, not espionage, and a recruitment method built so locals never learn who pays them.
sources: SCMP, 'Malaysia a target for Israeli spies over Gaza stance, Anwar warns', 22 Jul 2025 (article 3319134)

cards.h: Shalom Avitan flew in on a French passport, checked into a Kuala Lumpur hotel, and was caught with six pistols.
cards.s: Police suspected a Mossad covert operation; the 36-year-old claimed a family vendetta and was jailed seven years in February 2025, on firearms charges alone.
sources: BenarNews, 'Malaysia tightens security after arresting Israeli with guns', 29 Mar 2024
Times of Israel, Mar 2024; SCMP sentencing line, Feb 2025

cards.h: In 2022, eleven Malaysians were paid to kidnap a Palestinian for phone-hacking secrets, none knowing they served a foreign spy service.
cards.s: The police chief said that is the design: recruits get one task through cut-outs and never meet the principal, which is why intelligence found no Malaysian confirmed as an agent.
sources: Malay Mail, 'IGP says foreign spies might be in Malaysia, but intelligence reports show no locals are agents', 17 Nov 2023

cards.h: Putrajaya ties the threat to its Palestine stance, yet the police can only say incidents are 'under investigation'.
cards.s: No espionage conviction, no named Malaysian agent: the IGP confirmed reinforced screening of long-staying foreigners in July 2025 but stopped short of confirming any individual as a foreign operative.
sources: Scoop, 'Malaysia stepping up counter-intelligence efforts... IGP', 23 Jul 2025
Daily Express, 'Foreign spies including Mossad's might be in Malaysia, says IGP'

cards.text: The question is not whether Mossad is here. It is whether anyone could ever prove it, by the very design of how spies hire.

cards.h: Think of a contractor who hires day laborers through three middlemen.
cards.text: The workers swear they never met the boss, and they are telling the truth. That is what makes a spy service almost impossible to pin to the people it pays.
A spy threat can be real and unprovable at the same time. The honest position is the uncomfortable one: harden the door, and resist naming enemies the courts cannot convict.
sources: Synthesis of BenarNews 2024, Malay Mail 2023, SCMP/Scoop 2025
SCMP 3319134 (22 Jul 2025); Malay Mail 22 Jul 2025 + 17 Nov 2023; BenarNews 29 Mar 2024; Times of Israel Mar 2024; Scoop 23 Jul 2025; Daily Express IGP feature
confidence: Medium — arrest facts, sentence, and official statements are primary-sourced and cross-checked. The core attribution (that any individual is a Mossad agent) is explicitly unproven; cards state it as suspicion/claim, never fact.
needs_verification: Exact wording and venue of Anwar's 22 Jul 2025 statement — reporting paraphrases it; one rendered quote exists ('strong possibility that our firm position on Palestine has made Malaysia a target'). Confirm verbatim against a primary transcript or Bernama before publication.
Whether the Malaysian couple and driver arrested in the 2024 Avitan case have faced any espionage charge or conviction — no public record found; cards avoid asserting one.
The ~US$50,000 figure for Avitan's weapons purchase is single-sourced (Times of Israel); confirm or drop.
Precise count of loaded vs total firearms — BenarNews says three loaded; sentencing charge is six unlicensed firearms.
source_notes: CONTRADICTIONS handled: (1) Weapon count — BenarNews emphasizes 'three handguns loaded' without a total; the conviction charge and most outlets state six. Reconciled to six (anchored to the charge). (2) Mossad-vs-mobster — Malaysian police floated a covert-op theory; Avitan claimed a personal vendetta; Israeli media called him an alleged mobster. He was convicted only on firearms charges, so no card states he was a Mossad agent. (3) PM-vs-IGP — Anwar asserts active Mossad operations and local recruitment; the IGP (2023) said no local is confirmed as a turned agent and (Jul 2025) that incidents are merely 'under investigation'. This gap is the editorial spine, not smoothed over. Advocacy/state-aligned outlets (Al Mayadeen, PressTV, TRT, NMH, Crescent) were read for claims only and not relied on for any factual assertion. 3R discipline: all framing targets the state/agency and the method, never a people or a faith.
issue_headline: The Mossad Threat Malaysia Talks About But Cannot Confirm
